notes: Hard driven by dependent_stages (a multi-stage lifecycle: cache->offline reuse; train->serialize->reload-confirm->predict; rebuild; reconfigure), by reasoning_depth (reconstructing exact layer/shape/param-name architecture solely from a raw state dict, and slicing a classification head to an arbitrary label count while keeping config in sync), by tool_breadth (torch + transformers AutoModelForCausalLM/AutoTokenizer with local_files_only), and by hidden-case generalization (a different causal LM, a different state-dict shape, a different label count, unseen training data must all work via the same program). Malformed inputs (bad state file, header-only CSV, nonexistent cache, K=0, missing input) are fed and must fail cleanly, requiring defensive validation. Sanity is medium-weight data only, no GPU/resource pressure, so it caps out in the low-mid hard bucket.
